component.name: Popup
component.description: Low-level overlay primitive providing portal, overlay backdrop, and content positioning.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Element users activate to open the popup.

slots.name: overlay
slots.description: Optional backdrop layer rendered behind popup content.

own.name: children
own.description: Element that triggers the popup or additional content.

own.name: content
own.description: Modal content rendered inside the content surface.

own.name: dismissible
own.description: Whether outside interaction and Escape should dismiss the shell.

own.name: fullscreen
own.description: Whether the popup should cover the entire viewport.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier used to derive the content id.

own.name: onClosePrevent
own.description: Called when a dismissal attempt is blocked.

own.name: onOpenChange
own.description: Called whenever the open state changes.

own.name: overlay
own.description: Whether to render the overlay element.

own.name: scrollable
own.description: Whether to allow scrolling within the popup.
